[[Captain Quimang]], after receiving [[Togo's Ultimatum]], has decided to take action, and is following through with his threat regarding [[Tsumei Village]].  Once again, you have been in the right place at the wrong time, and have been "volunteered" to help in the defense.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
*Head to Sunqua Vale and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces.  [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
*Head to Panjiang Peninsula and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces.  [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
*See the Emperor's Blade for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,500 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

== Walkthrough ==
There is a two pronged attack of [[Crimson Skull]], from both sides of Tsumei Village. Start by defending the [[Sunqua Vale]] side: spread out near the portal and hold your position; the attackers will come to you. Once you have cleared out most of them, tackle the remaining stragglers. As soon as the quest updates (giving you credit for removing all groups), head back into town.

You can use the same tactics to defend the [[Panjiang Peninsula]] side, i.e. spread out and wait for the ''Skull'' to come to you. However, one of the groups will try to make an end run and attack you from behind. This can be an issue if you are using three [[henchman|henchmen]]; if you are, reposition your group closer to the [[resurrection shrine]] or otherwise backup so that the [[Canthan Guard]]s can take some of the aggro while you regroup. Groups of Crimson Skull will also appear away from the main fighting area and head into the village to attack the villagers. Killing these groups do ''not'' count towards completing the quest.

Once you receive credit for defeating the last group, head back into town to collect your reward.

: '''''Note:''' You must complete the Sunqua Vale part of the quest first or else the final group in Panjiang Peninsula will not spawn.''

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
:'''[[The Emperor's Blade]]'''
::''The emperor feared Captain Quimang would not see reason.  Scouts report that [[Master Togo|Togo]]'s former student has ordered his cohorts to attack Tsumei Village, and my forces from [[Kaineng City]] cannot possibly reach us in time now.  Yet we must go on the offensive to save Tsumei Village and the [[monastery]] that lies beyond it.  If you would serve your emperor, head to '''Sunqua Vale''' and '''Panjiang Pennisula''' {{sic}}.  Eliminate any '''Crimson Skull''' you see.  If you accept this task, heed one final warning: the Crimson Skull that besiege the village are numerous.  Only the bravest and strongest heroes have any hope of success.  Show no mercy; you will get none in return.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = The Crimson Skull will regret this.  I'll do it.

===Reward Dialogue===
:'''The Emperor's Blade'''
::''You have done well... Tsumei Village and [[Shing Jea Monastery]] are safe, for now.  But Quimang must still be taught a lesson about defying the emperor.''
